1	"""The proof chain (S9F Phase 3): evidence rows, test-order tickets, the owner's "Yes, I got it",
2	and the web client the checker uses to order from the shop like a customer would.
3	
4	Hops of a test order, each stored separately as Evidence:
5	  form_post      the shop's public form accepted the order (status code, order ref)
6	  smtp_accepted  our mail server accepted the email (message id). This is NOT delivery.
7	  imap_seen      the email was found in an inbox we can read (only mailboxes we hold)
8	  owner_confirmed the owner tapped "Yes, I got it" in the test email (single-use link)
9	"Accepted" is never shown as "delivered": only imap_seen or owner_confirmed count as delivered.
10	"""
11	
12	import secrets
13	from dataclasses import dataclass
14	from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
15	from html.parser import HTMLParser
16	from typing import Protocol
17	
18	from sqlmodel import Session, select
19	
20	from app import audit
21	from app.checks.safe_fetch import Page, SafeWeb
22	from app.config import Settings
23	from app.models import Business, Evidence, Order, TestTicket, utcnow
24	from app.safety.access import sha
25	
26	TICKET_MINUTES = 15  # the form POST must come this soon after the ticket
27	CONFIRM_DAYS = 7  # "Yes, I got it" works for a week, once
28	DELIVERED = ("imap_seen", "owner_confirmed")
29	STALE_HOURS = 24
30	
31	
32	def aware(when: datetime | None) -> datetime | None:
33	    return when if when is None or when.tzinfo else when.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
34	
35	
36	def shop_tag(business: Business) -> str:
37	    return business.subdomain or str(business.id)
38	
39	
40	def marker(business: Business) -> str:
41	    """The tag every shop page carries, so a parked page with a valid certificate can't pass as the shop."""
42	    return f'<meta name="lw-shop" content="{shop_tag(business)}">'
43	
44	
45	# ---------- evidence ----------
46	
47	def add(session: Session, *, business: Business, run_id: int | None, check: str, step: str, practice: bool,
48	        **fields) -> Evidence:
49	    row = Evidence(business_id=business.id, run_id=run_id, check=check, step=step, practice=practice, **fields)
50	    session.add(row)
51	    session.commit()
52	    session.refresh(row)
53	    return row
54	
55	
56	def evidence_for_run(session: Session, run_id: int) -> list[Evidence]:
57	    return list(session.exec(select(Evidence).where(Evidence.run_id == run_id).order_by(Evidence.id)).all())
58	
59	
60	# ---------- test-order tickets ----------
61	
62	def new_ticket(session: Session, business: Business, run_id: int | None) -> TestTicket:
63	    t = TestTicket(business_id=business.id, run_id=run_id, nonce=secrets.token_hex(8))
64	    session.add(t)
65	    session.commit()
66	    session.refresh(t)
67	    return t
68	
69	
70	def open_ticket(session: Session, business: Business, nonce: str) -> TestTicket | None:
71	    """The unused, recent ticket for THIS shop with this nonce, else None (then it's a normal order)."""
72	    if not nonce or len(nonce) > 64:
73	        return None
74	    t = session.exec(select(TestTicket).where(TestTicket.nonce == nonce, TestTicket.business_id == business.id)).first()
75	    if t is None or t.used_at is not None or utcnow() - aware(t.created_at) > timedelta(minutes=TICKET_MINUTES):
76	        return None
77	    return t
78	
79	
80	def ticket_used(session: Session, ticket: TestTicket, order: Order) -> None:
81	    ticket.used_at, ticket.order_id = utcnow(), order.id
82	    session.add(ticket)
83	    session.commit()
84	
85	
86	def issue_confirm_link(session: Session, settings: Settings, ticket: TestTicket) -> str:
87	    raw = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
88	    ticket.confirm_hash = sha(raw)
89	    session.add(ticket)
90	    session.commit()
91	    return f"{settings.app_base_url.rstrip('/')}/#/got-it?token={raw}"
92	
93	
94	def confirm(session: Session, raw: str) -> TestTicket | None:
95	    """The owner's tap. Works once, for a week. Writes `owner_confirmed` evidence on the ticket's run."""
96	    if not raw or len(raw) > 200:
97	        return None
98	    t = session.exec(select(TestTicket).where(TestTicket.confirm_hash == sha(raw))).first()
99	    if t is None or t.confirmed_at is not None or t.used_at is None:
100	        return None
101	    if utcnow() - aware(t.created_at) > timedelta(days=CONFIRM_DAYS):
102	        return None
103	    t.confirmed_at = utcnow()
104	    session.add(t)
105	    session.commit()
106	    b = session.get(Business, t.business_id)
107	    if b is not None:
108	        add(session, business=b, run_id=t.run_id, check="test_order", step="owner_confirmed", practice=b.practice,
109	            source="owner's tap on the test email", nonce=t.nonce)
110	        audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="test_order_confirmed", target=f"business:{b.id}", result="ok",
111	                     business_id=b.id, detail=f"code {t.nonce}")
112	    return t
113	
114	
115	# ---------- the web client the checker uses ----------
116	
117	class ShopWeb(Protocol):
118	    source: str
119	
120	    def get(self, url: str) -> Page: ...
121	    def post(self, url: str, fields: dict[str, str]) -> Page: ...
122	
123	
124	def real_shop_web(host: str, allow_private: bool = False) -> SafeWeb:
125	    """Over the internet, to this ONE shop host only (SSRF guard in SafeWeb)."""
126	    web = SafeWeb(lambda h: h == host.lower(), allow_private=allow_private)
127	    web.source = f"https://{host}"
128	    return web
129	
130	
131	class PracticeShopWeb:
132	    """Practice: the same page a customer would get (the shop template) and the same form handler,
133	    called in-process. Practice shops are never on the internet, so nothing else could be fetched."""
134	
135	    source = "practice: the shop page and form handler, in-process"
136	
137	    def __init__(self, session: Session, settings: Settings, mailer, business: Business, host: str):
138	        self.session, self.settings, self.mailer, self.business, self.host = session, settings, mailer, business, host
139	
140	    def _mine(self, url: str) -> bool:
141	        from urllib.parse import urlsplit
142	
143	        return (urlsplit(url).hostname or "").lower() == self.host.lower()
144	
145	    def get(self, url: str) -> Page:
146	        from app.agents.reader import Profile
147	        from app.sites.render import render_site
148	
149	        if not self._mine(url):
150	            return Page(404, "", url, error="not this shop")
151	        profile = Profile.model_validate_json(self.business.profile_json)
152	        return Page(200, render_site(profile, shop=shop_tag(self.business)), url, server="in-process")
153	
154	    def post(self, url: str, fields: dict[str, str]) -> Page:
155	        from app.agents.reader import Profile
156	        from app.sites.orders import accept_order_form
157	
158	        if not self._mine(url):
159	            return Page(404, "", url, error="not this shop")
160	        profile = Profile.model_validate_json(self.business.profile_json)
161	        status, html = accept_order_form(self.session, self.settings, self.mailer, business=self.business,
162	                                         profile=profile, form=fields, visitor="")
163	        return Page(status, html, url, server="in-process")
164	
165	
166	def in_process(ctx) -> PracticeShopWeb:
167	    """The fake world's way to reach a shop (also used by tests that stand in for the real server)."""
168	    return PracticeShopWeb(ctx.session, ctx.settings, ctx.integ.mailer, ctx.business, ctx.plan.site_host)
169	
170	
171	# ---------- reading the order form like a browser would ----------
172	
173	@dataclass
174	class OrderForm:
175	    action: str
176	    hidden: dict[str, str]
177	    qty_fields: list[str]
178	
179	
180	class _FormParser(HTMLParser):
181	    def __init__(self):
182	        super().__init__()
183	        self.form: OrderForm | None = None
184	        self._in = False
185	
186	    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
187	        a = dict(attrs)
188	        if tag == "form" and a.get("id") == "order-form" and (a.get("method") or "").lower() == "post":
189	            self.form, self._in = OrderForm(a.get("action") or "/", {}, []), True
190	        elif self._in and tag == "input" and a.get("name"):
191	            name = a["name"]
192	            if (a.get("type") or "").lower() == "hidden":
193	                self.form.hidden[name] = a.get("value") or ""
194	            elif name.startswith("qty_"):
195	                self.form.qty_fields.append(name)
196	
197	    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
198	        if tag == "form":
199	            self._in = False
200	
201	
202	def find_order_form(html: str) -> OrderForm | None:
203	    p = _FormParser()
204	    p.feed(html)
205	    return p.form if p.form and p.form.qty_fields else None
206	
207	
208	# ---------- what the report shows ----------
209	
210	STEP_TITLES = {"dns_answer": "Address answered", "http_response": "Page opened", "form_post": "Form accepted",
211	               "smtp_accepted": "Mail server accepted", "imap_seen": "In the inbox",
212	               "owner_confirmed": "Owner confirmed"}
213	
214	
215	def iso(v: datetime | None) -> str | None:
216	    return v.replace(tzinfo=None).isoformat() + "Z" if v else None
217	
218	
219	def evidence_out(e: Evidence) -> dict:
220	    return {"check": e.check, "step": e.step, "title": STEP_TITLES.get(e.step, e.step), "at": iso(e.at),
221	            "source": e.source, "server": e.server, "message_id": e.message_id, "status_code": e.status_code,
222	            "cert_not_after": iso(e.cert_not_after), "answer": e.answer[:200], "practice": e.practice}
223	
224	
225	def summary(session: Session, run: dict | None) -> dict:
226	    """'5 of 6 proven, 1 needs you', with the hops behind each check. Built only from stored evidence."""
227	    if not run:
228	        return {"proven": 0, "total": 0, "needs_you": 0, "checks": {}, "last_checked_at": None, "stale": False}
229	    rows = evidence_for_run(session, run["id"])
230	    by_check: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
231	    for e in rows:
232	        by_check.setdefault(e.check, []).append(evidence_out(e))
233	    proven = needs = 0
234	    for c in run["checks"]:
235	        hops = by_check.get(c["check"], [])
236	        c["hops"] = hops
237	        delivered = any(h["step"] in DELIVERED for h in hops)
238	        if c["check"] == "test_order" and c["passed"]:
239	            c["state"] = "proven" if delivered else "needs_you"
240	        else:
241	            c["state"] = "proven" if c["passed"] else "failed"
242	        proven += c["state"] == "proven"
243	        needs += c["state"] == "needs_you"
244	    finished = run.get("finished_at")
245	    stale = False
246	    if finished:
247	        at = datetime.fromisoformat(finished.rstrip("Z")).replace(tzinfo=UTC)
248	        stale = datetime.now(UTC) - at > timedelta(hours=STALE_HOURS)
249	    return {"proven": proven, "total": len(run["checks"]), "needs_you": needs, "last_checked_at": finished,
250	            "stale": stale}
251

"""Things that happen to a whole shop: taking it down, deleting it, clearing old guest workspaces."""

from datetime import timedelta

from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlmodel import Session, delete, select

from app import audit
from app.config import Settings
from app.integrations import Integrations
from app.models import (
    Alert,
    Approval,
    AuditEvent,
    Business,
    CheckResult,
    CheckRun,
    DnsBackup,
    Membership,
    Order,
    Plan,
    ShopReport,
    utcnow,
)
from app.sites.hosts import is_public

GUEST_HOURS = 24


def unpublish(session: Session, settings: Settings, integ: Integrations, b: Business) -> None:
    """Take a real shop off the internet: remove its address record (through the guarded client)
    and mark it not live. Best effort on the record: the shop is unpublished either way."""
    if not is_public(b):
        return
    try:
        if b.subdomain and settings.dns_mode != "wildcard":  # wildcard: the shop has no record of its own
            integ.godaddy.delete_records(settings.app_domain, "A", b.subdomain)
        result, detail = "ok", "address record removed"
    except Exception as e:  # the page is gone anyway (status), the stray record points at a 404
        result, detail = "failed", type(e).__name__
    b.status = "draft"
    session.add(b)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="system", action="unpublish", target=f"business:{b.id}", result=result,
                 business_id=b.id, detail=detail)


def purge_business(session: Session, settings: Settings, integ: Integrations, b: Business) -> None:
    """Delete a shop and everything personal that hangs off it (orders hold customers' names and
    phone numbers). The audit rows of the shop go too; the caller writes one anonymous record."""
    unpublish(session, settings, integ, b)
    delete_business_rows(session, b)
    session.commit()


def delete_business_rows(session: Session, b: Business) -> None:
    """Every row that belongs to the shop, children first (foreign keys are enforced), then the shop."""
    _purge_extra(session, b.id)
    for table in (Alert, CheckResult, CheckRun, Order, Approval, DnsBackup, AuditEvent, Membership, ShopReport):
        session.exec(delete(table).where(table.business_id == b.id))
    session.exec(delete(Plan).where(Plan.business_id == b.id))
    session.delete(b)


def _purge_extra(session: Session, business_id: int) -> None:
    """Tables added by later phases (evidence, shared reports) register here."""
    from app import models

    for name in ("Evidence", "ReportShare", "TestTicket", "ZoneFinding"):
        table = getattr(models, name, None)
        if table is not None:
            session.exec(delete(table).where(table.business_id == business_id))


def purge_old_guest_shops(engine: Engine, settings: Settings, integ: Integrations) -> int:
    """Guest practice workspaces live for 24 hours, then they are deleted."""
    with Session(engine) as s:
        cutoff = utcnow() - timedelta(hours=GUEST_HOURS)
        old = s.exec(select(Business).where(Business.guest_hash != "", Business.created_at < cutoff)).all()
        for b in old:
            purge_business(s, settings, integ, b)
        if old:
            audit.record(s, actor="system", action="guest_cleanup", result="ok", detail=f"{len(old)} practice shop(s) older than 24 h removed")
        return len(old)

58	    """Tiny forward-only migration: a table that already exists gets any column the models added
59	    since (SQLite `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` with the model's default). Never drops or rewrites."""
60	    from sqlalchemy import inspect, text

"""Database engine and session helpers (SQLite via SQLModel)."""

from collections.abc import Iterator
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy import event
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool
from sqlmodel import Session, SQLModel, create_engine

from app import models  # noqa: F401  (registers tables on SQLModel.metadata)
from app.config import get_settings

_engine: Engine | None = None


BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000


def _sqlite_pragmas(dbapi_conn, _record, *, wal: bool) -> None:
    """Set on EVERY new connection: wait up to 5 s for a lock instead of failing at once, enforce
    foreign keys, and (file databases) use WAL so readers never block the one writer."""
    cur = dbapi_conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(f"PRAGMA busy_timeout={BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS}")
    cur.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    if wal:
        cur.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        cur.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")  # safe with WAL; a power cut loses at most the last commit
    cur.close()


def make_engine(database_url: str) -> Engine:
    if database_url in ("sqlite://", "sqlite:///:memory:"):
        # One shared in-memory DB across threads (tests).
        engine = create_engine(
            "sqlite://",
            connect_args={"check_same_thread": False},
            poolclass=StaticPool,
        )
        event.listen(engine, "connect", lambda c, r: _sqlite_pragmas(c, r, wal=False))
        return engine
    if database_url.startswith("sqlite:///"):
        Path(database_url.removeprefix("sqlite:///")).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    engine = create_engine(database_url, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
    if database_url.startswith("sqlite"):
        event.listen(engine, "connect", lambda c, r: _sqlite_pragmas(c, r, wal=True))
    return engine


def get_engine() -> Engine:
    global _engine
    if _engine is None:
        _engine = make_engine(get_settings().database_url)
    return _engine


def add_missing_columns(engine: Engine) -> list[str]:
    """Tiny forward-only migration: a table that already exists gets any column the models added
    since (SQLite `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` with the model's default). Never drops or rewrites."""
    from sqlalchemy import inspect, text

    added: list[str] = []
    insp = inspect(engine)
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        for table in SQLModel.metadata.sorted_tables:
            if not insp.has_table(table.name):
                continue
            have = {c["name"] for c in insp.get_columns(table.name)}
            for col in table.columns:
                if col.name in have:
                    continue
                default = col.default.arg if col.default is not None and not callable(col.default.arg) else None
                ddl = f'ALTER TABLE "{table.name}" ADD COLUMN "{col.name}" {col.type.compile(engine.dialect)}'
                if default is not None:
                    value = int(default) if isinstance(default, bool) else default
                    ddl += " DEFAULT " + (str(value) if isinstance(value, (int, float)) else "'" + str(value).replace("'", "''") + "'")
                conn.execute(text(ddl))
                added.append(f"{table.name}.{col.name}")
    return added


def init_db(engine: Engine | None = None) -> None:
    engine = engine or get_engine()
    SQLModel.metadata.create_all(engine)
    add_missing_columns(engine)


def get_session() -> Iterator[Session]:
    """FastAPI dependency. Tests override this."""
    with Session(get_engine()) as session:
        yield session

30	def unpublish(session: Session, settings: Settings, integ: Integrations, b: Business) -> None:
31	    """Take a real shop off the internet: remove its address record (through the guarded client)
32	    and mark it not live. Best effort on the record: the shop is unpublished either way."""
33	    if not is_public(b):
34	        return
35	    try:
36	        if b.subdomain and settings.dns_mode != "wildcard":  # wildcard: the shop has no record of its own
37	            integ.godaddy.delete_records(settings.app_domain, "A", b.subdomain)
38	        result, detail = "ok", "address record removed"
39	    except Exception as e:  # the page is gone anyway (status), the stray record points at a 404
40	        result, detail = "failed", type(e).__name__
41	    b.status = "draft"
42	    session.add(b)
43	    session.commit()
44	    audit.record(session, actor="system", action="unpublish", target=f"business:{b.id}", result=result,
45	                 business_id=b.id, detail=detail)

48	def purge_business(session: Session, settings: Settings, integ: Integrations, b: Business) -> None:
49	    """Delete a shop and everything personal that hangs off it (orders hold customers' names and
50	    phone numbers). The audit rows of the shop go too; the caller writes one anonymous record."""
51	    unpublish(session, settings, integ, b)
52	    delete_business_rows(session, b)
53	    session.commit()

56	def delete_business_rows(session: Session, b: Business) -> None:
57	    """Every row that belongs to the shop, children first (foreign keys are enforced), then the shop."""
58	    _purge_extra(session, b.id)
59	    for table in (Alert, CheckResult, CheckRun, Order, Approval, DnsBackup, AuditEvent, Membership, ShopReport):
60	        session.exec(delete(table).where(table.business_id == b.id))
61	    session.exec(delete(Plan).where(Plan.business_id == b.id))
62	    session.delete(b)

65	def _purge_extra(session: Session, business_id: int) -> None:
66	    """Tables added by later phases (evidence, shared reports) register here."""
67	    from app import models
68	
69	    for name in ("Evidence", "ReportShare", "TestTicket", "ZoneFinding"):
70	        table = getattr(models, name, None)
71	        if table is not None:

20	def _sqlite_pragmas(dbapi_conn, _record, *, wal: bool) -> None:
21	    """Set on EVERY new connection: wait up to 5 s for a lock instead of failing at once, enforce
22	    foreign keys, and (file databases) use WAL so readers never block the one writer."""
23	    cur = dbapi_conn.cursor()
24	    cur.execute(f"PRAGMA busy_timeout={BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS}")
25	    cur.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
26	    if wal:
27	        cur.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
28	        cur.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")  # safe with WAL; a power cut loses at most the last commit
29	    cur.close()

32	def make_engine(database_url: str) -> Engine:
33	    if database_url in ("sqlite://", "sqlite:///:memory:"):
34	        # One shared in-memory DB across threads (tests).
35	        engine = create_engine(
36	            "sqlite://",
37	            connect_args={"check_same_thread": False},
38	            poolclass=StaticPool,
39	        )
40	        event.listen(engine, "connect", lambda c, r: _sqlite_pragmas(c, r, wal=False))
41	        return engine
42	    if database_url.startswith("sqlite:///"):
43	        Path(database_url.removeprefix("sqlite:///")).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
44	    engine = create_engine(database_url, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
45	    if database_url.startswith("sqlite"):
46	        event.listen(engine, "connect", lambda c, r: _sqlite_pragmas(c, r, wal=True))
47	    return engine

57	def add_missing_columns(engine: Engine) -> list[str]:
58	    """Tiny forward-only migration: a table that already exists gets any column the models added
59	    since (SQLite `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` with the model's default). Never drops or rewrites."""
60	    from sqlalchemy import inspect, text
61	
62	    added: list[str] = []
63	    insp = inspect(engine)
64	    with engine.begin() as conn:
65	        for table in SQLModel.metadata.sorted_tables:
66	            if not insp.has_table(table.name):
67	                continue
68	            have = {c["name"] for c in insp.get_columns(table.name)}
69	            for col in table.columns:
70	                if col.name in have:
71	                    continue
72	                default = col.default.arg if col.default is not None and not callable(col.default.arg) else None
73	                ddl = f'ALTER TABLE "{table.name}" ADD COLUMN "{col.name}" {col.type.compile(engine.dialect)}'
74	                if default is not None:
75	                    value = int(default) if isinstance(default, bool) else default
76	                    ddl += " DEFAULT " + (str(value) if isinstance(value, (int, float)) else "'" + str(value).replace("'", "''") + "'")
77	                conn.execute(text(ddl))
78	                added.append(f"{table.name}.{col.name}")
79	    return added

    result: str,

    detail: str = "",

        action=action,
        target=target,
        result=result,
        detail=detail,
    )
    session.add(event)
    session.commit()
    session.refresh(event)
    return event

"""Session 9F Phase 3: the order proof chain, shared reports, and "Check any address"."""

from datetime import UTC, date, datetime, timedelta

import httpx
import pytest
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import proof
from app.checks.dns_resolver import AuthoritativeResolver
from app.checks.safe_fetch import Page, Refused, SafeWeb
from app.models import AddressCheck, AuditEvent, Business, Evidence, Order, ReportShare, TestTicket
from app.routers.health import mailbox_warning
from app.routers.proof import get_public_dns, get_public_web
from tests.conftest import publish, set_user, sign_in
from tests.test_m3_launch import approve, meera, plan
from tests.test_m4_report import real_plan, two_worlds_client
from tests.test_s9_phase2_access import make_app


def report(c, biz):
    r = c.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/report")
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    return r.json()


def hops(engine, check="test_order"):
    with Session(engine) as s:
        return [e.step for e in s.exec(select(Evidence).where(Evidence.check == check).order_by(Evidence.id)).all()]


# ---------- hops recorded separately, practice labelled ----------

def test_practice_launch_records_each_hop_with_times(client, engine):
    biz = meera(client)
    approve(client, plan(client, biz))
    assert hops(engine) == ["form_post", "smtp_accepted", "imap_seen"]
    assert hops(engine, "site_points") == ["dns_answer"] and hops(engine, "https") == ["http_response"]
    with Session(engine) as s:
        rows = s.exec(select(Evidence)).all()
        assert all(e.practice for e in rows)  # pretend world: always labelled
        smtp = next(e for e in rows if e.step == "smtp_accepted")
        assert smtp.message_id and smtp.nonce and smtp.server == "pretend mail server"
        assert next(e for e in rows if e.step == "dns_answer").server == "pretend nameserver"
    rep = report(client, biz)
    assert rep["practice"] is True and rep["proof"]["proven"] == rep["proof"]["total"] == 7
    test = next(c for c in rep["run"]["checks"] if c["check"] == "test_order")
    assert [h["title"] for h in test["hops"]] == ["Form accepted", "Mail server accepted", "In the inbox"]
    assert all(h["at"] for h in test["hops"]) and rep["proof"]["stale"] is False


def test_test_order_goes_through_the_public_form_and_stays_hidden(client, engine):
    biz = meera(client)
    approve(client, plan(client, biz))
    with Session(engine) as s:
        order = s.exec(select(Order)).one()
        ticket = s.exec(select(TestTicket)).one()
        assert order.is_test and order.nonce == ticket.nonce and ticket.order_id == order.id and ticket.used_at
        assert order.client_token  # the form's own hidden token was posted back, like a browser does
    assert client.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/orders").json() == []  # hidden from the seller's list


def test_new_code_every_run_and_old_emails_never_pass(client, engine, integ):
    biz = meera(client)
    approve(client, plan(client, biz))
    first = integ.inbox.messages[-1]
    integ.mailer.drop = True  # the next test email never arrives...
    integ.inbox.deliver(sender="x", to="y", subject=first.subject, body="old copy",
                        at=datetime.now(UTC) - timedelta(days=2))  # ...but an old one with an old code is there
    client.post(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/checks")

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(_app: FastAPI):
    from app import singleton

    # ONE process only: the scheduler runs in-process and SQLite has one writer. A second worker
    # would send every alert and daily test order twice, so it refuses to start.
    singleton.acquire(get_settings().database_url)
    init_db()
    from app.db import get_engine
    from app.startup import reconcile

    closed = reconcile(get_engine())  # close launches / check runs that lost their worker in a restart
    logging.getLogger("launchwitness").warning("startup reconcile: %s", closed)
    settings = get_settings()
    from app.accounts import ensure_admin
    from app.integrations import get_practice_integrations
    from app.tenancy import purge_old_guest_shops

    ensure_admin(get_engine(), settings)  # the ADMIN_EMAIL account exists and is the admin
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="demo_fault_switch", target=body.fault or "off", result="ok",
                 business_id=b.id, detail="armed: removed before the next check" if body.fault else "disarmed")
    return {"ok": True, "demo_fault": b.demo_fault}


@router.delete("/admin/practice-businesses/{business_id}", dependencies=[Depends(require_admin)])
def delete_practice_business(business_id: int, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> dict:
    """Demo reset (scripts/seed_demo.py --reset): remove a PRACTICE business and all its rows.
    Real businesses are never deleted this way."""
    from app.tenancy import delete_business_rows

    b = session.get(Business, business_id)
    if b is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="We couldn't find that business.")
    if not b.practice:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Only practice businesses can be deleted here.")
    name = b.name
    delete_business_rows(session, b)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="admin", action="delete_practice_business", target=f"business:{business_id}",
                 result="ok", detail=name)

"""Tamper-evident proof log (S11d): every Evidence row is a link in a per-shop hash chain.

  hash = sha256(prev_hash + canonical_json(row fields))      first row: prev_hash = genesis(shop)

Canonical JSON: sorted keys, no whitespace, ASCII, times as UTC ISO with microseconds. The row id is
NOT hashed: order is proven by the prev_hash links (walked in id order), so one INSERT writes a row.

Evidence is append-only: `append` is the only way in, updates are refused, deletes are refused except
inside `purge` (a shop or account being deleted). What this does NOT prove: someone who can write the
database file can rewrite a whole chain, or cut rows off its end. A receipt (the chain head) that
somebody saved earlier is what such a rewrite cannot match.
"""

import hashlib
import json
import threading
from collections.abc import Mapping
from contextvars import ContextVar
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import event, or_, update
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session as SASession
from sqlalchemy.orm import object_session
from sqlmodel import Session, delete, func, select

from app import audit
from app.models import Evidence

# Every stored fact of a row. A new Evidence column must be added here (a test checks the list).
FIELDS = ("business_id", "run_id", "check", "step", "at", "source", "server", "message_id", "nonce",
          "status_code", "cert_not_after", "answer", "practice")
RECEIPT_LEN = 12

_LOCK = threading.Lock()  # one app process (app.singleton): this lock makes "read head, insert" atomic
_purging: ContextVar[bool] = ContextVar("evidence_purging", default=False)


class AppendOnly(RuntimeError):
    """Evidence rows are never changed or removed (only a whole shop's chain, by `purge`)."""


def genesis(business_id: int) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(f"launchwitness:evidence-chain:v1:{business_id}".encode()).hexdigest()


def _utc(v: datetime) -> datetime:
    return v.replace(tzinfo=UTC) if v.tzinfo is None else v.astimezone(UTC)


def _plain(v):
    return _utc(v).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ") if isinstance(v, datetime) else v


def canonical(row: Mapping | Evidence) -> str:
    get = row.__getitem__ if isinstance(row, Mapping) else lambda f: getattr(row, f)
    data = {f: _plain(get(f)) for f in FIELDS}
    data["practice"] = bool(data["practice"])
    return json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True)


def row_hash(prev_hash: str, row: Mapping | Evidence) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256((prev_hash + canonical(row)).encode()).hexdigest()


def append(session: Session, row: Evidence) -> Evidence:
    """THE way an evidence row is written: take the shop's chain head and insert, in one transaction."""
    for f in ("at", "cert_not_after"):  # SQLite keeps the wall-clock digits only: make them UTC first
        if isinstance(getattr(row, f), datetime):
            setattr(row, f, _utc(getattr(row, f)))
    with _LOCK:
        head = session.exec(select(Evidence.hash).where(Evidence.business_id == row.business_id)
                            .order_by(Evidence.id.desc()).limit(1)).first()
        row.prev_hash = head or genesis(row.business_id)
        row.hash = row_hash(row.prev_hash, row)
        session.add(row)
        session.commit()
    session.refresh(row)
    return row


def verify(session: Session, business_id: int) -> dict:
    """Recompute the shop's chain. Only counts and hashes come out: never a row's contents.
    `altered_at` is the 1-based position of the first row that doesn't fit."""
    rows = session.exec(select(Evidence).where(Evidence.business_id == business_id).order_by(Evidence.id)).all()
    prev = genesis(business_id)
    for n, row in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        if row.prev_hash != prev or row.hash != row_hash(prev, row):
            return {"intact": False, "altered_at": n}
        prev = row.hash
    return {"intact": True, "rows": len(rows), "head": prev if rows else ""}


def receipt(session: Session, business_id: int) -> str:
    """First 12 hex of the chain head ("" when the shop has no evidence yet)."""
    head = session.exec(select(Evidence.hash).where(Evidence.business_id == business_id)
                        .order_by(Evidence.id.desc()).limit(1)).first()
    return (head or "")[:RECEIPT_LEN]


def purge(session: Session, business_id: int) -> int:
    """Remove a shop's whole chain (the shop is being deleted). Returns how many rows went. No commit."""
    n = session.exec(select(func.count()).select_from(Evidence).where(Evidence.business_id == business_id)).one()
    token = _purging.set(True)
    try:
        session.exec(delete(Evidence).where(Evidence.business_id == business_id))
    finally:
        _purging.reset(token)
    return n


def backfill(engine: Engine) -> int:
    """Startup migration, once: rows written before S11d get their links, per shop, in id order.
    The chain can only vouch for those rows as they were at this moment."""
    t = Evidence.__table__
    unchained = or_(t.c.hash == "", t.c.hash.is_(None))
    done = 0
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        shops = conn.execute(select(t.c.business_id).where(unchained).distinct().order_by(t.c.business_id)).scalars().all()
        for business_id in shops:
            prev = genesis(business_id)
            for r in conn.execute(select(t).where(t.c.business_id == business_id).order_by(t.c.id)).mappings().all():
                if r["hash"]:
                    prev = r["hash"]
                    continue
                h = row_hash(prev, r)
                conn.execute(update(t).where(t.c.id == r["id"]).values(prev_hash=prev, hash=h))
                prev, done = h, done + 1
    if done:
        with Session(engine) as s:
            audit.record(s, actor="system", action="evidence_chain_backfilled", result="ok",
                         detail=f"{done} earlier proof row(s) in {len(shops)} shop(s) chained; the chain starts here")
    return done

@event.listens_for(Evidence, "before_update")
def _no_update(_mapper, _conn, target) -> None:
    s = object_session(target)
    if s is None or s.is_modified(target):
        raise AppendOnly("evidence rows are never changed")


@event.listens_for(Evidence, "before_delete")
def _no_delete(_mapper, _conn, _target) -> None:
    raise AppendOnly("evidence rows are never deleted one by one")


@event.listens_for(SASession, "do_orm_execute")
def _no_bulk_change(state) -> None:
    if not (state.is_update or state.is_delete):
        return
    mapper = state.bind_mapper
    if mapper is not None and mapper.class_ is Evidence and (state.is_update or not _purging.get()):
        raise AppendOnly("evidence rows are never changed or deleted (only a whole shop's chain, on purge)")

"""Tamper-evident proof log (S11d): every Evidence row is a link in a per-shop hash chain.

  hash = sha256(prev_hash + canonical_json(row fields))      first row: prev_hash = genesis(shop)

Canonical JSON: sorted keys, no whitespace, ASCII, times as UTC ISO with microseconds. The row id is
NOT hashed: order is proven by the prev_hash links (walked in id order), so one INSERT writes a row.

Evidence is append-only: `append` is the only way in, updates are refused, deletes are refused except
inside `purge` (a shop or account being deleted). What this does NOT prove: someone who can write the
database file can rewrite a whole chain, or cut rows off its end. A receipt (the chain head) that
somebody saved earlier is what such a rewrite cannot match.
"""

import hashlib
import json
import threading
from collections.abc import Mapping
from contextvars import ContextVar
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import event, or_, update
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session as SASession
from sqlalchemy.orm import object_session
from sqlmodel import Session, delete, func, select

from app import audit
from app.models import Evidence

# Every stored fact of a row. A new Evidence column must be added here (a test checks the list).
FIELDS = ("business_id", "run_id", "check", "step", "at", "source", "server", "message_id", "nonce",
          "status_code", "cert_not_after", "answer", "practice")
RECEIPT_LEN = 12

_LOCK = threading.Lock()  # one app process (app.singleton): this lock makes "read head, insert" atomic
_purging: ContextVar[bool] = ContextVar("evidence_purging", default=False)


class AppendOnly(RuntimeError):
    """Evidence rows are never changed or removed (only a whole shop's chain, by `purge`)."""


def genesis(business_id: int) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(f"launchwitness:evidence-chain:v1:{business_id}".encode()).hexdigest()


def _utc(v: datetime) -> datetime:
    return v.replace(tzinfo=UTC) if v.tzinfo is None else v.astimezone(UTC)


def _plain(v):
    return _utc(v).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ") if isinstance(v, datetime) else v


def canonical(row: Mapping | Evidence) -> str:
    get = row.__getitem__ if isinstance(row, Mapping) else lambda f: getattr(row, f)
    data = {f: _plain(get(f)) for f in FIELDS}
    data["practice"] = bool(data["practice"])
    return json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True)


def row_hash(prev_hash: str, row: Mapping | Evidence) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256((prev_hash + canonical(row)).encode()).hexdigest()


def append(session: Session, row: Evidence) -> Evidence:
    """THE way an evidence row is written: take the shop's chain head and insert, in one transaction."""
    for f in ("at", "cert_not_after"):  # SQLite keeps the wall-clock digits only: make them UTC first
        if isinstance(getattr(row, f), datetime):
            setattr(row, f, _utc(getattr(row, f)))
    with _LOCK:
        head = session.exec(select(Evidence.hash).where(Evidence.business_id == row.business_id)
                            .order_by(Evidence.id.desc()).limit(1)).first()
        row.prev_hash = head or genesis(row.business_id)
        row.hash = row_hash(row.prev_hash, row)
        session.add(row)
        session.commit()
    session.refresh(row)
    return row


def verify(session: Session, business_id: int) -> dict:
    """Recompute the shop's chain. Only counts and hashes come out: never a row's contents.
    `altered_at` is the 1-based position of the first row that doesn't fit."""
    rows = session.exec(select(Evidence).where(Evidence.business_id == business_id).order_by(Evidence.id)).all()
    prev = genesis(business_id)
    for n, row in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        if row.prev_hash != prev or row.hash != row_hash(prev, row):
            return {"intact": False, "altered_at": n}
        prev = row.hash
    return {"intact": True, "rows": len(rows), "head": prev if rows else ""}


def receipt(session: Session, business_id: int) -> str:
    """First 12 hex of the chain head ("" when the shop has no evidence yet)."""
    head = session.exec(select(Evidence.hash).where(Evidence.business_id == business_id)
                        .order_by(Evidence.id.desc()).limit(1)).first()
    return (head or "")[:RECEIPT_LEN]


def purge(session: Session, business_id: int) -> int:
    """Remove a shop's whole chain (the shop is being deleted). Returns how many rows went. No commit."""
    n = session.exec(select(func.count()).select_from(Evidence).where(Evidence.business_id == business_id)).one()
    token = _purging.set(True)
    try:
        session.exec(delete(Evidence).where(Evidence.business_id == business_id))
    finally:
        _purging.reset(token)
    return n


def backfill(engine: Engine) -> int:
    """Startup migration, once: rows written before S11d get their links, per shop, in id order.
    The chain can only vouch for those rows as they were at this moment."""
    t = Evidence.__table__
    unchained = or_(t.c.hash == "", t.c.hash.is_(None))
    done = 0
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        shops = conn.execute(select(t.c.business_id).where(unchained).distinct().order_by(t.c.business_id)).scalars().all()
        for business_id in shops:
            prev = genesis(business_id)
            for r in conn.execute(select(t).where(t.c.business_id == business_id).order_by(t.c.id)).mappings().all():
                if r["hash"]:
                    prev = r["hash"]
                    continue
                h = row_hash(prev, r)
                conn.execute(update(t).where(t.c.id == r["id"]).values(prev_hash=prev, hash=h))
                prev, done = h, done + 1
    if done:
        with Session(engine) as s:
            audit.record(s, actor="system", action="evidence_chain_backfilled", result="ok",
                         detail=f"{done} earlier proof row(s) in {len(shops)} shop(s) chained; the chain starts here")
    return done


# ---------- append-only guards (the ORM refuses; anything done behind its back, verify() finds) ----------

@event.listens_for(Evidence, "before_update")
def _no_update(_mapper, _conn, target) -> None:
    s = object_session(target)
    if s is None or s.is_modified(target):
        raise AppendOnly("evidence rows are never changed")


@event.listens_for(Evidence, "before_delete")
def _no_delete(_mapper, _conn, _target) -> None:
    raise AppendOnly("evidence rows are never deleted one by one")


@event.listens_for(SASession, "do_orm_execute")
def _no_bulk_change(state) -> None:
    if not (state.is_update or state.is_delete):
        return
    mapper = state.bind_mapper
    if mapper is not None and mapper.class_ is Evidence and (state.is_update or not _purging.get()):
        raise AppendOnly("evidence rows are never changed or deleted (only a whole shop's chain, on purge)")

"""Database engine and session helpers (SQLite via SQLModel)."""

from collections.abc import Iterator
from pathlib import Path

from sqlalchemy import event
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlalchemy.pool import StaticPool
from sqlmodel import Session, SQLModel, create_engine

from app import models  # noqa: F401  (registers tables on SQLModel.metadata)
from app.config import get_settings

_engine: Engine | None = None


BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000


def _sqlite_pragmas(dbapi_conn, _record, *, wal: bool) -> None:
    """Set on EVERY new connection: wait up to 5 s for a lock instead of failing at once, enforce
    foreign keys, and (file databases) use WAL so readers never block the one writer."""
    cur = dbapi_conn.cursor()
    cur.execute(f"PRAGMA busy_timeout={BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS}")
    cur.execute("PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON")
    if wal:
        cur.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        cur.execute("PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL")  # safe with WAL; a power cut loses at most the last commit
    cur.close()


def make_engine(database_url: str) -> Engine:
    if database_url in ("sqlite://", "sqlite:///:memory:"):
        # One shared in-memory DB across threads (tests).
        engine = create_engine(
            "sqlite://",
            connect_args={"check_same_thread": False},
            poolclass=StaticPool,
        )
        event.listen(engine, "connect", lambda c, r: _sqlite_pragmas(c, r, wal=False))
        return engine
    if database_url.startswith("sqlite:///"):
        Path(database_url.removeprefix("sqlite:///")).parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    engine = create_engine(database_url, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
    if database_url.startswith("sqlite"):
        event.listen(engine, "connect", lambda c, r: _sqlite_pragmas(c, r, wal=True))
    return engine


def get_engine() -> Engine:
    global _engine
    if _engine is None:
        _engine = make_engine(get_settings().database_url)
    return _engine


def add_missing_columns(engine: Engine) -> list[str]:
    """Tiny forward-only migration: a table that already exists gets any column the models added
    since (SQLite `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN` with the model's default). Never drops or rewrites."""
    from sqlalchemy import inspect, text

    added: list[str] = []
    insp = inspect(engine)
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        for table in SQLModel.metadata.sorted_tables:
            if not insp.has_table(table.name):
                continue
            have = {c["name"] for c in insp.get_columns(table.name)}
            for col in table.columns:
                if col.name in have:
                    continue
                default = col.default.arg if col.default is not None and not callable(col.default.arg) else None
                ddl = f'ALTER TABLE "{table.name}" ADD COLUMN "{col.name}" {col.type.compile(engine.dialect)}'
                if default is not None:
                    value = int(default) if isinstance(default, bool) else default
                    ddl += " DEFAULT " + (str(value) if isinstance(value, (int, float)) else "'" + str(value).replace("'", "''") + "'")
                conn.execute(text(ddl))
                added.append(f"{table.name}.{col.name}")
    return added


def init_db(engine: Engine | None = None) -> None:
    engine = engine or get_engine()
    SQLModel.metadata.create_all(engine)
    add_missing_columns(engine)


def get_session() -> Iterator[Session]:
    """FastAPI dependency. Tests override this."""
    with Session(get_engine()) as session:
        yield session

"""Things that happen to a whole shop: taking it down, deleting it, clearing old guest workspaces."""

from datetime import timedelta

from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlmodel import Session, delete, select

from app import audit
from app.config import Settings
from app.integrations import Integrations
from app.models import (
    Alert,
    Approval,
    AuditEvent,
    Business,
    CheckResult,
    CheckRun,
    DnsBackup,
    Membership,
    Order,
    Plan,
    ShopReport,
    utcnow,
)
from app.sites.hosts import is_public

GUEST_HOURS = 24


def unpublish(session: Session, settings: Settings, integ: Integrations, b: Business) -> None:
    """Take a real shop off the internet: remove its address record (through the guarded client)
    and mark it not live. Best effort on the record: the shop is unpublished either way."""
    if not is_public(b):
        return
    try:
        if b.subdomain and settings.dns_mode != "wildcard":  # wildcard: the shop has no record of its own
            integ.godaddy.delete_records(settings.app_domain, "A", b.subdomain)
        result, detail = "ok", "address record removed"
    except Exception as e:  # the page is gone anyway (status), the stray record points at a 404
        result, detail = "failed", type(e).__name__
    b.status = "draft"
    session.add(b)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="system", action="unpublish", target=f"business:{b.id}", result=result,
                 business_id=b.id, detail=detail)


def purge_business(session: Session, settings: Settings, integ: Integrations, b: Business) -> None:
    """Delete a shop and everything personal that hangs off it (orders hold customers' names and
    phone numbers). The audit rows of the shop go too; the caller writes one anonymous record."""
    unpublish(session, settings, integ, b)
    delete_business_rows(session, b)
    session.commit()


def delete_business_rows(session: Session, b: Business) -> None:
    """Every row that belongs to the shop, children first (foreign keys are enforced), then the shop."""
    _purge_extra(session, b.id)
    for table in (Alert, CheckResult, CheckRun, Order, Approval, DnsBackup, AuditEvent, Membership, ShopReport):
        session.exec(delete(table).where(table.business_id == b.id))
    session.exec(delete(Plan).where(Plan.business_id == b.id))
    session.delete(b)


def _purge_extra(session: Session, business_id: int) -> None:
    """Tables added by later phases (evidence, shared reports) register here."""
    from app import models

    for name in ("Evidence", "ReportShare", "TestTicket", "ZoneFinding"):
        table = getattr(models, name, None)
        if table is not None:
            session.exec(delete(table).where(table.business_id == business_id))


def purge_old_guest_shops(engine: Engine, settings: Settings, integ: Integrations) -> int:
    """Guest practice workspaces live for 24 hours, then they are deleted."""
    with Session(engine) as s:
        cutoff = utcnow() - timedelta(hours=GUEST_HOURS)
        old = s.exec(select(Business).where(Business.guest_hash != "", Business.created_at < cutoff)).all()
        for b in old:
            purge_business(s, settings, integ, b)
        if old:
            audit.record(s, actor="system", action="guest_cleanup", result="ok", detail=f"{len(old)} practice shop(s) older than 24 h removed")
        return len(old)

def walk(routes) -> Iterator:
    """Every real route of the app, including those inside included routers."""
    for r in routes:
        inner = getattr(r, "original_router", None)
        if inner is not None:
            yield from walk(inner.routes)
        else:
            yield r


def app_routes(app) -> list[tuple[str, str, object]]:
    """(METHOD, path, route) for every route; a mounted directory is METHOD "MOUNT"."""
    out = []
    for r in walk(app.routes):
        methods = [m for m in (getattr(r, "methods", None) or []) if m not in ("HEAD", "OPTIONS")]
        if not methods:
            out.append(("MOUNT", r.path, r))
        out.extend((m, r.path, r) for m in sorted(methods))
    return out


def gate_calls(route) -> set[str]:
    """Names of every dependency function the route uses (searched through sub-dependencies)."""
    seen: set[str] = set()

    def visit(dep) -> None:
        for d in getattr(dep, "dependencies", []):
            call = getattr(d, "call", None)
            if call is not None:
                seen.add(getattr(call, "__name__", ""))
            visit(d)

    if getattr(route, "dependant", None) is not None:
        visit(route.dependant)
    return seen

"""Tamper-evident proof log (S11d): every Evidence row is a link in a per-shop hash chain.

  hash = sha256(prev_hash + canonical_json(row fields))      first row: prev_hash = genesis(shop)

Canonical JSON: sorted keys, no whitespace, ASCII, times as UTC ISO with microseconds. The row id is
NOT hashed: order is proven by the prev_hash links (walked in id order), so one INSERT writes a row.

Evidence is append-only: `append` is the only way in, updates are refused, deletes are refused except
inside `purge` (a shop or account being deleted). What this does NOT prove: someone who can write the
database file can rewrite a whole chain, or cut rows off its end. A receipt (the chain head) that
somebody saved earlier is what such a rewrite cannot match.
"""

import hashlib
import json
import threading
from collections.abc import Mapping
from contextvars import ContextVar
from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import event, or_, update
from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session as SASession
from sqlalchemy.orm import object_session
from sqlmodel import Session, delete, func, select

from app import audit
from app.models import Evidence

# Every stored fact of a row. A new Evidence column must be added here (a test checks the list).
FIELDS = ("business_id", "run_id", "check", "step", "at", "source", "server", "message_id", "nonce",
          "status_code", "cert_not_after", "answer", "practice")
RECEIPT_LEN = 12

_LOCK = threading.Lock()  # one app process (app.singleton): this lock makes "read head, insert" atomic
_purging: ContextVar[bool] = ContextVar("evidence_purging", default=False)


class AppendOnly(RuntimeError):
    """Evidence rows are never changed or removed (only a whole shop's chain, by `purge`)."""


def genesis(business_id: int) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(f"launchwitness:evidence-chain:v1:{business_id}".encode()).hexdigest()


def _utc(v: datetime) -> datetime:
    return v.replace(tzinfo=UTC) if v.tzinfo is None else v.astimezone(UTC)


def _plain(v):
    return _utc(v).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ") if isinstance(v, datetime) else v


def canonical(row: Mapping | Evidence) -> str:
    get = row.__getitem__ if isinstance(row, Mapping) else lambda f: getattr(row, f)
    data = {f: _plain(get(f)) for f in FIELDS}
    data["practice"] = bool(data["practice"])
    return json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=True)


def row_hash(prev_hash: str, row: Mapping | Evidence) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256((prev_hash + canonical(row)).encode()).hexdigest()


def append(session: Session, row: Evidence) -> Evidence:
    """THE way an evidence row is written: take the shop's chain head and insert, in one transaction."""
    for f in ("at", "cert_not_after"):  # SQLite keeps the wall-clock digits only: make them UTC first
        if isinstance(getattr(row, f), datetime):
            setattr(row, f, _utc(getattr(row, f)))
    with _LOCK:
        head = session.exec(select(Evidence.hash).where(Evidence.business_id == row.business_id)
                            .order_by(Evidence.id.desc()).limit(1)).first()
        row.prev_hash = head or genesis(row.business_id)
        row.hash = row_hash(row.prev_hash, row)
        session.add(row)
        session.commit()
    session.refresh(row)
    return row


def verify(session: Session, business_id: int) -> dict:
    """Recompute the shop's chain. Only counts and hashes come out: never a row's contents.
    `altered_at` is the 1-based position of the first row that doesn't fit."""
    rows = session.exec(select(Evidence).where(Evidence.business_id == business_id).order_by(Evidence.id)).all()
    prev = genesis(business_id)
    for n, row in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        if row.prev_hash != prev or row.hash != row_hash(prev, row):
            return {"intact": False, "altered_at": n}
        prev = row.hash
    return {"intact": True, "rows": len(rows), "head": prev if rows else ""}


def receipt(session: Session, business_id: int) -> str:
    """First 12 hex of the chain head ("" when the shop has no evidence yet)."""
    head = session.exec(select(Evidence.hash).where(Evidence.business_id == business_id)
                        .order_by(Evidence.id.desc()).limit(1)).first()
    return (head or "")[:RECEIPT_LEN]


def purge(session: Session, business_id: int) -> int:
    """Remove a shop's whole chain (the shop is being deleted). Returns how many rows went. No commit."""
    n = session.exec(select(func.count()).select_from(Evidence).where(Evidence.business_id == business_id)).one()
    token = _purging.set(True)
    try:

def backfill(engine: Engine) -> int:
    """Startup migration, once: rows written before S11d get their links, per shop, in id order.
    The chain can only vouch for those rows as they were at this moment."""
    t = Evidence.__table__
    unchained = or_(t.c.hash == "", t.c.hash.is_(None))
    done = 0
    with engine.begin() as conn:
        shops = conn.execute(select(t.c.business_id).where(unchained).distinct().order_by(t.c.business_id)).scalars().all()
        for business_id in shops:
            prev = genesis(business_id)
            for r in conn.execute(select(t).where(t.c.business_id == business_id).order_by(t.c.id)).mappings().all():
                if r["hash"]:
                    prev = r["hash"]
                    continue
                h = row_hash(prev, r)
                conn.execute(update(t).where(t.c.id == r["id"]).values(prev_hash=prev, hash=h))
                prev, done = h, done + 1
    if done:
        with Session(engine) as s:
            audit.record(s, actor="system", action="evidence_chain_backfilled", result="ok",
                         detail=f"{done} earlier proof row(s) in {len(shops)} shop(s) chained; the chain starts here")
    return done

@event.listens_for(Evidence, "before_update")
def _no_update(_mapper, _conn, target) -> None:
    s = object_session(target)
    if s is None or s.is_modified(target):
        raise AppendOnly("evidence rows are never changed")


@event.listens_for(Evidence, "before_delete")
def _no_delete(_mapper, _conn, _target) -> None:
    raise AppendOnly("evidence rows are never deleted one by one")


@event.listens_for(SASession, "do_orm_execute")
def _no_bulk_change(state) -> None:
    if not (state.is_update or state.is_delete):
        return
    mapper = state.bind_mapper
    if mapper is not None and mapper.class_ is Evidence and (state.is_update or not _purging.get()):
        raise AppendOnly("evidence rows are never changed or deleted (only a whole shop's chain, on purge)")

"check again now" mon = Monitor(engine, settings, lambda _b: integ, claude) for kind in ("quick", "daily"): mon.check_business(biz["id"], kind) after = state(engine, biz["id"]) assert after["intact"] is True and after["rows"] > first["rows"] and after["head"] != first["head"] with Session(engine) as s: rows = s.exec(select(Evidence).where(Evidence.business_id == biz["id"]).order_by(Evidence.id)).all() assert rows[0].prev_hash == chain.genesis(biz["id"]) assert all(b.prev_hash == a.hash for a, b in zip(rows, rows[1:], strict=False)) def test_each_shop_has_its_own_chain(client, new_client, engine): a, b = launched(client), launched(new_client()) assert chain.genesis(a["id"]) != chain.genesis(b["id"]) sa, sb = state(engine, a["id"]), state(engine, b["id"]) assert sa["intact"] and sb["intact"] and sa["head"] != sb["head"] raw(engine, "UPDATE evidence SET answer = 'x' WHERE id = :i", i=ids(engine, b["id"])[0]) assert state(engine, a["id"]) == sa and state(engine, b["id"]) == {"intact": False, "altered_at": 1} def test_the_hash_covers_every_stored_field(): stored = set(Evidence.model_fields) - {"id", "prev_hash", "hash"} assert set(chain.FIELDS) == stored # a new Evidence column must join the hash def test_canonical_json_is_stable_and_times_are_utc(): at = datetime(2026, 11, 16, 9, 30, 0, 123456, tzinfo=UTC) row = Evidence(business_id=7, run_id=None, check="https", step="http_response", at=at, answer="é ok") text_ = chain.canonical(row) assert text_ == ('{"answer":"\\u00e9 ok","at":"2026-11-16T09:30:00.123456Z","business_id":7,"cert_not_after":null,' '"check":"https","message_id":"","nonce":"","practice":false,"run_id":null,"server":"",' '"source":"","status_code":null,"step":"http_response"}') row.at = at.replace(tzinfo=None) # as SQLite hands it back assert chain.canonical(row) == text_ row.at = at.astimezone(timezone(timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30))) # the same moment in IST assert chain.canonical(row) == text_ def test_a_time_in_another_zone_still_verifies(client, engine): biz = launched(client) ist = timezone(timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30)) with Session(engine) as s: proof.add(s, business=s.get(Business, biz["id"]), run_id=None, check="https", step="http_response", practice=True, cert_not_after=datetime(2027, 1, 1, 12, 0, tzinfo=ist)) assert state(engine, biz["id"])["intact"] is True # ---------- tampering is found, at the right place ---------- EDITS = {"business_id": None, "run_id": 987654, "check": "'email_ready'", "step": "'imap_seen'", "at": "'2020-01-01 00:00:00.000000'", "source": "'elsewhere'", "server": "'10.0.0.1'", "message_id": "''", "nonce": "'feedfacefeedface'", "status_code": 201, "cert_not_after": "'2031-01-01 00:00:00.000000'", "answer": "'forged'", "practice": 0, "prev_hash": "'" + "0" * 64 + "'", "hash": "'" + "f" * 64 + "'"} @pytest.mark.parametrize("field", [f for f in EDITS if f != "business_id"]) def test_editing_any_field_of_any_row_is_detected(client, engine, field): biz = launched(client) rows = ids(engine, biz["id"]) for position in (1, len(rows) // 2 + 1, len(rows)): target = rows[position - 1] with Session(engine) as s: before = dict(s.connection().execute(text("SELECT * FROM evidence WHERE id = :i"), {"i": target}).mappings().one()) raw(engine, f'UPDATE evidence SET "{field}" = {EDITS[field]} WHERE id = :i', i=target) assert state(engine, biz["id"]) == {"intact": False, "altered_at": position}, (field, position) raw(engine, f'UPDATE evidence SET "{field}" = :v WHERE id = :i', v=before[field], i=target) # put it back assert state(engine, biz["id"])["intact"] is True def test_moving_a_row_to_another_shop_is_detected(client, new_client, engine): a, b = launched(client), launched(new_client()) rows_a, n_b = ids(engine, a["id"]), len(ids(engine, b["id"])) raw(engine, "UPDATE evidence SET business_id = :b WHERE id = :i", b=b["id"], i=rows_a[2]) assert state(engine, a["id"]) == {"intact": False, "altered_at": 3} # a's chain has a hole broken_b = state(engine, b["id"]) assert broken_b["intact"] is False and 1 <= broken_b["altered_at"] <= n_b + 1 # and b's a stranger def test_reordering_rows_is_detected(client, engine): biz = launched(client) rows = ids(engine, biz["id"]) x, y = rows[2], rows[3] raw(engine, "UPDATE evidence SET id = -1 WHERE id = :x", x=x) raw(engine, "UPDATE evidence SET id = :x WHERE id = :y", x=x, y=y) raw(engine, "UPDATE evidence SET id = :y WHERE id = -1", y=y) assert state(engine, biz["id"]) == {"intact": False, "altered_at": 3} def test_deleting_a_middle_row_is_detected(client, engine): biz = launched(client) raw(engine, "DELETE FROM evidence WHERE id = :i", i=ids(engine, biz["id"])[3]) assert state(engine, biz["id"]) == {"intact": False, "altered_at": 4} # once init_db(engine) # every later start: nothing to do, nothing changes assert state(engine, biz["id"]) == want with Session(engine) as s: assert len(s.exec(select(AuditEvent).where(AuditEvent.action == "evidence_chain_backfilled")).all()) == 1 def test_startup_migration_adds_the_columns_and_chains_an_old_database(tmp_path): old = make_engine(f"sqlite:///{(tmp_path / 'old.db').as_posix()}") with old.begin() as conn: # the evidence table as it was before S11d, with two rows conn.execute(text("CREATE TABLE business (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)")) conn.execute(text('CREATE TABLE evidence (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, business_id INTEGER NOT NULL, run_id INTEGER,' ' "check" VARCHAR NOT NULL, step VARCHAR NOT NULL, at DATETIME NOT NULL, source VARCHAR NOT NULL,' ' server VARCHAR NOT NULL, message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, nonce VARCHAR NOT NULL, status_code INTEGER,' ' cert_not_after DATETIME, answer VARCHAR NOT NULL, practice BOOLEAN NOT NULL)')) for i, step in ((1, "dns_answer"), (2, "http_response")): conn.execute(text("INSERT INTO evidence VALUES (:i, 5, 1, 'https', :s, '2026-11-10 08:00:00.000000', 'ns', '', ''," " '', 200, NULL, 'ok', 0)"), {"i": i, "s": step}) from sqlmodel import SQLModel from app.db import add_missing_columns SQLModel.metadata.tables["evidence"] # the model is registered assert {"evidence.prev_hash", "evidence.hash"} <= set(add_missing_columns(old)) assert chain.backfill(old) == 2 with Session(old) as s: assert chain.verify(s, 5)["intact"] is True and chain.verify(s, 5)["rows"] == 2 old.dispose() # described, never launched path = share_path(client, biz) assert "Receipt" not in new_client().get(path).text assert new_client().get(path + "/verify").json() == {"intact": True, "rows": 0, "head": ""} def test_revoked_paused_or_unknown_share_is_404(client, new_client, engine): biz = launched(client) path = share_path(client, biz) visitor = new_client() assert visitor.get(path + "/verify").status_code == 200 with Session(engine) as s: b = s.get(Business, biz["id"]) b.paused = True s.add(b) s.commit() assert visitor.get(path + "/verify").status_code == 404 and visitor.get(path).status_code == 404 with Session(engine) as s: b = s.get(Business, biz["id"]) b.paused = False s.add(b) s.commit() assert visitor.get(path + "/verify").status_code == 200 client.delete(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/share") gone = visitor.get(path + "/verify") assert gone.status_code == 404 and set(gone.json()) == {"detail"} and "head" not in gone.text assert visitor.get("/r/not-a-real-token/verify").status_code == 404 def test_verify_is_rate_limited_per_visitor(client, new_client): biz = launched(client) path = share_path(client, biz) one = new_client() for _ in range(proof_routes.VERIFY_PER_MINUTE): assert one.get(path + "/verify").status_code == 200 assert one.get(path + "/verify").status_code == 429 assert one.get("/r/guess/verify").status_code == 429 # input.content: """Session 11d: the tamper-evident proof log (per-shop hash chain over Evidence rows).""" from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta, timezone import pytest from sqlalchemy import text from sqlmodel import Session, delete, select from app import chain, proof from app.db import init_db, make_engine from app.models import AuditEvent, Business, Evidence from app.monitor.scheduler import Monitor from app.routers import proof as proof_routes from tests.test_m3_launch import approve, meera, plan @pytest.fixture(autouse=True) def fresh_rate_limit(): proof_routes._verify_hits.clear() yield proof_routes._verify_hits.clear() def launched(client) -> dict: biz = meera(client) approve(client, plan(client, biz)) return biz def share_path(client, biz) -> str: return "/r/" + client.post(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/share").json()["url"].rsplit("/r/", 1)[1] def state(engine, business_id: int) -> dict: with Session(engine) as s: return chain.verify(s, business_id) def ids(engine, business_id: int) -> list[int]: with Session(engine) as s: return list(s.exec(select(Evidence.id).where(Evidence.business_id == business_id).order_by(Evidence.id)).all()) def raw(engine, sql: str, **params) -> None: """Someone with the database file, going behind the app's back.""" with engine.begin() as conn: conn.execute(text(sql), params) # ---------- normal life is always intact ---------- def test_launch_checks_and_monitoring_keep_the_chain_intact(client, engine, settings, integ, claude): biz = launched(client) first = state(engine, biz["id"]) assert first["intact"] is True and first["rows"] >= 5 and len(first["head"]) == 64 assert client.post(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/checks").status_code == 202 # "check again now" mon = Monitor(engine, settings, lambda _b: integ, claude) for kind in ("quick", "daily"): mon.check_business(biz["id"], kind) after = state(engine, biz["id"]) assert after["intact"] is True and after["rows"] > first["rows"] and after["head"] != first["head"] with Session(engine) as s: rows = s.exec(select(Evidence).where(Evidence.business_id == biz["id"]).order_by(Evidence.id)).all() assert rows[0].prev_hash == chain.genesis(biz["id"]) assert all(b.prev_hash == a.hash for a, b in zip(rows, rows[1:], strict=False)) def test_each_shop_has_its_own_chain(client, new_client, engine): a, b = launched(client), launched(new_client()) assert chain.genesis(a["id"]) != chain.genesis(b["id"]) sa, sb = state(engine, a["id"]), state(engine, b["id"]) assert sa["intact"] and sb["intact"] and sa["head"] != sb["head"] raw(engine, "UPDATE evidence SET answer = 'x' WHERE id = :i", i=ids(engine, b["id"])[0]) assert state(engine, a["id"]) == sa and state(engine, b["id"]) == {"intact": False, "altered_at": 1} def test_the_hash_covers_every_stored_field(): stored = set(Evidence.model_fields) - {"id", "prev_hash", "hash"} assert set(chain.FIELDS) == stored # a new Evidence column must join the hash def test_canonical_json_is_stable_and_times_are_utc(): at = datetime(2026, 11, 16, 9, 30, 0, 123456, tzinfo=UTC) row = Evidence(business_id=7, run_id=None, check="https", step="http_response", at=at, answer="é ok") text_ = chain.canonical(row) assert text_ == ('{"answer":"\\u00e9 ok","at":"2026-11-16T09:30:00.123456Z","business_id":7,"cert_not_after":null,' '"check":"https","message_id":"","nonce":"","practice":false,"run_id":null,"server":"",' '"source":"","status_code":null,"step":"http_response"}') row.at = at.replace(tzinfo=None) # as SQLite hands it back assert chain.canonical(row) == text_ row.at = at.astimezone(timezone(timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30))) # the same moment in IST assert chain.canonical(row) == text_ def test_a_time_in_another_zone_still_verifies(client, engine): biz = launched(client) ist = timezone(timedelta(hours=5, minutes=30)) with Session(engine) as s: proof.add(s, business=s.get(Business, biz["id"]), run_id=None, check="https", step="http_response", practice=True, cert_not_after=datetime(2027, 1, 1, 12, 0, tzinfo=ist)) assert state(engine, biz["id"])["intact"] is True # ---------- tampering is found, at the right place ---------- EDITS = {"business_id": None, "run_id": 987654, "check": "'email_ready'", "step": "'imap_seen'", "at": "'2020-01-01 00:00:00.000000'", "source": "'elsewhere'", "server": "'10.0.0.1'", "message_id": "''", "nonce": "'feedfacefeedface'", "status_code": 201, "cert_not_after": "'2031-01-01 00:00:00.000000'", "answer": "'forged'", "practice": 0, "prev_hash": "'" + "0" * 64 + "'", "hash": "'" + "f" * 64 + "'"} @pytest.mark.parametrize("field", [f for f in EDITS if f != "business_id"]) def test_editing_any_field_of_any_row_is_detected(client, engine, field): biz = launched(client) rows = ids(engine, biz["id"]) for position in (1, len(rows) // 2 + 1, len(rows)): target = rows[position - 1] with Session(engine) as s: before = dict(s.connection().execute(text("SELECT * FROM evidence WHERE id = :i"), {"i": target}).mappings().one()) raw(engine, f'UPDATE evidence SET "{field}" = {EDITS[field]} WHERE id = :i', i=target) assert state(engine, biz["id"]) == {"intact": False, "altered_at": position}, (field, position) raw(engine, f'UPDATE evidence SET "{field}" = :v WHERE id = :i', v=before[field], i=target) # put it back assert state(engine, biz["id"])["intact"] is True def test_moving_a_row_to_another_shop_is_detected(client, new_client, engine): a, b = launched(client), launched(new_client()) rows_a, n_b = ids(engine, a["id"]), len(ids(engine, b["id"])) raw(engine, "UPDATE evidence SET business_id = :b WHERE id = :i", b=b["id"], i=rows_a[2]) assert state(engine, a["id"]) == {"intact": False, "altered_at": 3} # a's chain has a hole broken_b = state(engine, b["id"]) assert broken_b["intact"] is False and 1 <= broken_b["altered_at"] <= n_b + 1 # and b's a stranger def test_reordering_rows_is_detected(client, engine): biz = launched(client) rows = ids(engine, biz["id"]) x, y = rows[2], rows[3] raw(engine, "UPDATE evidence SET id = -1 WHERE id = :x", x=x) raw(engine, "UPDATE evidence SET id = :x WHERE id = :y", x=x, y=y) raw(engine, "UPDATE evidence SET id = :y WHERE id = -1", y=y) assert state(engine, biz["id"]) == {"intact": False, "altered_at": 3} def test_deleting_a_middle_row_is_detected(client, engine): biz = launched(client) raw(engine, "DELETE FROM evidence WHERE id = :i", i=ids(engine, biz["id"])[3]) assert state(engine, biz["id"]) == {"intact": False, "altered_at": 4} # the row that followed it def test_inserting_a_row_is_detected(client, engine): biz = launched(client) rows = ids(engine, biz["id"]) with Session(engine) as s: third = s.get(Evidence, rows[2]) forged = Evidence(business_id=biz["id"], run_id=third.run_id, check="test_order", step="owner_confirmed", practice=True, at=third.at) prev, when = third.hash, third.at forged.prev_hash, forged.hash = prev, chain.row_hash(prev, forged) # a careful forger: links it properly # make room after row 3, then slip the forged row in as the 4th for i in reversed(rows[3:]): raw(engine, "UPDATE evidence SET id = id + 1000 WHERE id = :i", i=i) raw(engine, "INSERT INTO evidence (id, business_id, run_id, \"check\", step, at, source, server, message_id, nonce," " answer, practice, prev_hash, hash) VALUES (:id, :b, :r, 'test_order', 'owner_confirmed', :at, '', ''," " '', '', '', 1, :p, :h)", id=rows[2] + 1, b=biz["id"], r=forged.run_id, at=when, p=prev, h=forged.hash) assert state(engine, biz["id"]) == {"intact": False, "altered_at": 5} # the old 4th row no longer follows raw(engine, "UPDATE evidence SET hash = 'junk' WHERE id = :i", i=rows[2] + 1) # a careless forger assert state(engine, biz["id"]) == {"intact": False, "altered_at": 4} # ---------- append-only in code ---------- def test_code_refuses_to_update_or_delete_evidence(client, engine): from sqlalchemy import update biz = launched(client) before = state(engine, biz["id"]) with Session(engine) as s: row = s.exec(select(Evidence)).first() row.answer = "changed" s.add(row) with pytest.raises(chain.AppendOnly): s.commit() with Session(engine) as s: with pytest.raises(chain.AppendOnly): s.delete(s.exec(select(Evidence)).first()) s.commit() with Session(engine) as s: with pytest.raises(chain.AppendOnly): s.exec(delete(Evidence).where(Evidence.business_id == biz["id"])) with pytest.raises(chain.AppendOnly): s.exec(update(Evidence).values(answer="changed")) assert state(engine, biz["id"]) == before # ---------- backfill ---------- def test_backfill_chains_old_rows_once_and_the_same_way_every_time(client, engine, tmp_path): biz = launched(client) want = state(engine, biz["id"]) with Session(engine) as s: chained = [(e.id, e.prev_hash, e.hash) for e in s.exec(select(Evidence).order_by(Evidence.id)).all()] raw(engine, "UPDATE evidence SET prev_hash = '', hash = ''") # as if written before S11d assert state(engine, biz["id"])["intact"] is False assert chain.backfill(engine) == want["rows"] with Session(engine) as s: assert [(e.id, e.prev_hash, e.hash) for e in s.exec(select(Evidence).order_by(Evidence.id)).all()] == chained logged = s.exec(select(AuditEvent).where(AuditEvent.action == "evidence_chain_backfilled")).all() assert len(logged) == 1 and logged[0].business_id is None and "chain starts here" in logged[0].detail assert state(engine, biz["id"]) == want assert chain.backfill(engine) == 0 # once init_db(engine) # every later start: nothing to do, nothing changes assert state(engine, biz["id"]) == want with Session(engine) as s: assert len(s.exec(select(AuditEvent).where(AuditEvent.action == "evidence_chain_backfilled")).all()) == 1 def test_startup_migration_adds_the_columns_and_chains_an_old_database(tmp_path): old = make_engine(f"sqlite:///{(tmp_path / 'old.db').as_posix()}") with old.begin() as conn: # the evidence table as it was before S11d, with two rows conn.execute(text("CREATE TABLE business (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)")) conn.execute(text('CREATE TABLE evidence (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, business_id INTEGER NOT NULL, run_id INTEGER,' ' "check" VARCHAR NOT NULL, step VARCHAR NOT NULL, at DATETIME NOT NULL, source VARCHAR NOT NULL,' ' server VARCHAR NOT NULL, message_id VARCHAR NOT NULL, nonce VARCHAR NOT NULL, status_code INTEGER,' ' cert_not_after DATETIME, answer VARCHAR NOT NULL, practice BOOLEAN NOT NULL)')) for i, step in ((1, "dns_answer"), (2, "http_response")): conn.execute(text("INSERT INTO evidence VALUES (:i, 5, 1, 'https', :s, '2026-11-10 08:00:00.000000', 'ns', '', ''," " '', 200, NULL, 'ok', 0)"), {"i": i, "s": step}) from sqlmodel import SQLModel from app.db import add_missing_columns SQLModel.metadata.tables["evidence"] # described, never launched path = share_path(client, biz) assert "Receipt" not in new_client().get(path).text assert new_client().get(path + "/verify").json() == {"intact": True, "rows": 0, "head": ""} def test_revoked_paused_or_unknown_share_is_404(client, new_client, engine): biz = launched(client) path = share_path(client, biz) visitor = new_client() assert visitor.get(path + "/verify").status_code == 200 with Session(engine) as s: b = s.get(Business, biz["id"]) b.paused = True s.add(b) s.commit() assert visitor.get(path + "/verify").status_code == 404 and visitor.get(path).status_code == 404 with Session(engine) as s: b = s.get(Business, biz["id"]) b.paused = False s.add(b) s.commit() assert visitor.get(path + "/verify").status_code == 200 client.delete(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/share") gone = visitor.get(path + "/verify") assert gone.status_code == 404 and set(gone.json()) == {"detail"} and "head" not in gone.text assert visitor.get("/r/not-a-real-token/verify").status_code == 404 def test_verify_is_rate_limited_per_visitor(client, new_client): biz = launched(client) path = share_path(client, biz) one = new_client() for _ in range(proof_routes.VERIFY_PER_MINUTE): assert one.get(path + "/verify").status_code == 200 assert one.get(path + "/verify").status_code == 429 assert one.get("/r/guess/verify").status_code == 429 # **Tamper-evident proof log (S11d).** Every evidence row is a link in a per-shop hash chain:
`hash = sha256(prev_hash + canonical JSON of the row)`, the first row chaining from a fixed per-shop start value. Evidence
is append-only in code (no updates, no deletes; only deleting a shop or account removes its whole chain, with one anonymous
audit event). The shared report shows "Receipt <first 12 hex of the newest hash> · verify"; the public
`GET /r/<token>/verify` recomputes the chain and answers only `{"intact": true, "rows": N, "head": "..."}` or
`{"intact": false, "altered_at": N}`, never any evidence or customer data. It catches an edited, reordered, removed or
inserted row. Honest limit: someone who can rewrite the whole database can rebuild a chain or cut rows off its end; only a
receipt that somebody saved earlier would not match.
